bio: Gabriele Memmo, a shrewd and industrious Popolani merchant of Venice, has risen from humble origins through strategic investment and tireless effort. Born to a family of bakers with distant claims to more illustrious ancestry, Gabriele abandoned the family trade to pursue greater fortunes in commerce.
